The '''59th [[Writers Guild of America Award]]s''' honored the best [[film writer|film]] and [[television writer]]s of 2006.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2012-2006 |title=Writers Guild Awards Winners: 2012-2006 |work=wga.org |publisher=Writers Guild of America |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251228141617/https://awards.wga.org/awards/nominees-winners/2012-2006 |archive-date=2025-12-28 |access-date=2026-02-20 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.imdb.com/event/ev0000710/2007/1/|title=Writers Guild of America, USA (2007)|website=IMDb|access-date=2026-02-20}}</ref>
